theorems.name: Submission.cmr_null_of_div_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (ν : Measure X) (q : X → Euclid n) (h : X → ℝ) (Λ : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasure ν → Measurable q → Integrable h ν → (∀ g : Euclid n → Euclid n, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → |∫ x, h x * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid n) (fderiv ℝ g (q x)).toLinearMap ∂ν| ≤ Λ) → ∀ K : Set (Euclid n), IsCompact K → volume K = 0 → ∫ x in q ⁻¹' K, h x ∂ν = 0
